# Amazing Little Bites Event Management

> Mobile dessert and snack cart catering business ("Amazing Little Bites") serving Orange
> County, Los Angeles County, Riverside County, and San Bernardino County, California. Brings
> a customizable dessert and snack cart to quinceañeras, sweet 16s, weddings, birthday
> parties, and other celebrations.

## Facts

- Business name: Amazing Little Bites Event Management (also known as Amazing Little Bites)
- Service area: Orange County, CA (primary); Los Angeles County, CA; Riverside County, CA;
  San Bernardino County, CA
- Hours: Monday–Saturday 11am–8pm, closed Sunday
- Office: Anaheim, CA
- Phone: 714-783-6605 (Julio), 714-783-6615 (Nicole)
- Email: Amazinglittlebites24@outlook.com
- Event types served: quinceañeras, sweet 16s, weddings, birthday parties
